description: This file contains test support utilities for WebSocket interactions in a Gateway testing context, including mock implementations of WebSocket tasks and sessions, as well as some extensions and helper functions to facilitate testing of WebSocket communication, particularly for OpenClaw gateway-related features.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketTask
classes.description: A mock WebSocket task implementing WebSocketTasking protocol, used for testing WebSocket interactions, supporting hooks for send and receive operations, and managing internal state for simulation.

classes.name: GatewayTestWebSocketSession
classes.description: A mock WebSocket session implementing WebSocketSessioning protocol, capable of creating and managing multiple mock WebSocket tasks for testing purposes.

methods.name: sendPing
methods.description: Extends WebSocketTasking to keep unit-test doubles resilient to protocol additions by immediately invoking the pong receive handler.

methods.name: connectChallengeData
methods.description: Generates a Data object containing a JSON string representing a challenge event with a nonce for connection testing.

methods.name: connectRequestID
methods.description: Extracts the request ID from a WebSocket message if it corresponds to a connect request.

methods.name: connectOkData
methods.description: Returns a Data object with JSON representing a successful connection response including server info and features.

methods.name: connectAuthFailureData
methods.description: Builds a Data object with JSON indicating an authentication failure, including error details and optional recommended next steps.

methods.name: requestID
methods.description: Retrieves the request ID from a WebSocket message if it is a request.

methods.name: okResponseData
methods.description: Provides a Data object with JSON representing an OK response message.
